Hi Lucas —

Thanks again for the time earlier. To get the POC launched with momentum, we'd like to run a two-part working session next week: a stakeholder roundtable (intros, goals, success criteria, routing & security alignment) followed by a hands-on lab focused on prompt review, routing rules, and a small-scale load test so we can baseline latency/cost.

Proposed schedule (PT):
- Option A — Mon, Oct 19, 10:00–11:30 (90 min) — combined roundtable + lab
- Option B — Tue, Oct 20, 09:00–10:30 (90 min)
- Option C — split: Wed, Oct 21, 10:00–11:00 (60 min kickoff) + Thu, Oct 22, 10:00–11:30 (90 min hands-on lab)

Agenda (draft):
- 10 min: intros & roles (who owns what)
- 15 min: goals, success criteria, and acceptance tests
- 25 min: prompt review & routing strategy (function triggers, fallback models)
- 30+ min: hands-on prompt tuning + small load sweep (KV cache behavior, batching)
- 10 min: next steps & responsibilities

Prework (attached): prework-prompt-sets.md (sample prompt set), short questionnaire for SRE/security, and a preliminary load-test plan. Can you confirm who from Finexa should be at the roundtable? We'd specifically like an SRE/systems contact (for routing/load test alignment) and a security/compliance contact for data handling & retention constraints. Also flag if procurement needs a separate session to review pricing/terms before the lab.

If you prefer the split approach (Option C) we'll do an abbreviated kickoff first and then the longer hands-on lab where Diego will lead the prompt tuning and load sweep. Please reply with preferred option and any additional folks to include.

Thanks —
